reviews.comment: Dr. Behie has a great industry experience but he is not a great instructor. Lectures are unstructured. It is hard to follow the logic of each topic or find connections between topics. There is no real homework to assist in exams preps. Exams are closed book, be prepared to see questions that you never seen before. Avoid him if you have an option.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class
